lxc_ca042d43e0858159.text: In the European Union, fourteen allergens are regulated.

lxc_37508493e506d169.text: Sellers of non-prepacked food, including food at restaurant and deli counters, must provide allergen information.

lxc_d19c1a3a7b87bc09.text: They may explain it aloud, and written information must be available on request.

lxc_82914f90a1a707d6.text: This helps, but it is not a promise that cross-contact cannot happen.

lxc_8f8b8093e7d679de.text: A little of another food may touch the dish during preparation.

lxc_e34510f2f7a11a86.text: Say exactly what you cannot eat, ask to see the written information, and listen to the answer.

lxc_85947488fa8f4f19.text: If the answer is not safe or clear enough for you, choose something else.

lxc_1a78dbc1eda7d046.text: Never guess about a serious allergy.

lxc_4e4aa928c3acd40b.text: Food may be sold by piece or by weight.

lxc_d867507b2e9dd947.text: For one bread roll, say, “Two of these, please,” and point.

lxc_63222542e0d8a6ae.text: For a practice cheese order, say, “Half a kilo, please,” or ask for a smaller amount.

lxc_50558fb53a050c6d.text: The seller can stop when you say, “That’s enough, thank you.” You can also ask what is local or popular.

lxc_ee48988465fecafc.text: Ask for a small sample only when it seems possible; the seller may say yes or no.

lxc_68a6b7bff76c5273.text: Before the seller prepares the order, check payment with “Do you take cards?” or “Is it cash only?” This avoids a problem after the food is ready.

lxc_7ffd5470c2fb0b98.text: Food markets can be open-air, covered, or inside food halls.

lxc_43f0a1d13dbad7e1.text: A few clear questions help you choose food, check allergens, pay, and handle tips.

lxc_598306569a4f3f0f.text: Buying food at European food markets becomes easier when you know the basic layout.

lxc_2f0aa48c0de454b8.text: An open-air market has stalls outside.

lxc_878c310b7c8deac3.text: A covered market puts the stalls under one roof.

lxc_e565ca57851f6c60.text: A food hall is usually inside and often has places to sit.

lxc_5d10806bf3111ffe.text: Any of these places may sell ingredients, ready-to-eat dishes, or both.

lxc_7f0e5dad299a5f2a.text: Picture fruit in Barcelona, a warm lunch in Paris, and bread in London.

lxc_757506a63857ef77.text: First, walk around and look at the displayed price.

lxc_0fce06efb629980b.text: Notice whether people order at a counter or sit at a table.

lxc_6b57d7701345b935.text: These details help you know how to buy, eat, and pay.

lxc_0ed1ed08c54347cb.text: Local market cultures differ, so watch first and ask politely when you are unsure.

lxc_3eb07de3125a25f8.text: The seller has local tomatoes and accepts card payment in this exercise.
